title: Count digit-multiplication steps
summary: A number puzzle repeatedly multiplies the decimal digits of an integer until a single digit remains. Count how many multiplication rounds are required. Count how many times digits must be multiplied together to produce a single-digit result.
requirements: Input is a nonnegative safe integer.
A single-digit input requires zero steps.
hints: One step replaces n with the product of its digits.
Repeat while more than one digit remains.
